subQuests.subQuestName: Attend the meeting at Favonius Keep

160100101.text: After updating Varka on the situation in Mondstadt, you explain the relationship between the God of the North Wind and the Bloodstained Knight to the attendees...

160100102.text: ...And that's where things stand. The Wild Hunt is no longer under the Rächer of Solnari's control, but it has been reborn from the ashes and is now launching widespread attacks.

160100103.text: Intel from the Frostmoon Scions and the Curatorium of Secrets corroborates this. No disturbances have been detected in the space where Rerir resides. What we are facing here is a completely new foe.

160100104.text: Summarizing current situation... To confirm — the present leader of the Wild Hunt is the creature resembling a wolf? Andrius, God of the North Wind...

160100105.text: More precisely, it's the external will that has seized control of Andrius's spirit... namely Roland, the Bloodstained Knight.

160100106.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hold on, I'm completely lost! Isn't Roland some Mondstadter from, like, 500 years ago?

160100107.text: How'd he suddenly get wrapped up with a god from a thousand years in the past AND the present-day Wild Hunt?

160100108.text: Allow us to explain that part.

160100109.text: Are you familiar with compensation mechanisms? When an organism sustains damage, relevant tissues will undergo changes to offset the loss of function...

160100110.text: For example, when one kidney is damaged, the other will be strengthened to compensate. Or, when a main artery is blocked, the collateral vessels become more active...

160100111.text: Similarly, when the Wild Hunt lost their leader, the Abyss harnessed the memories that flow throughout the Ley Lines to fashion a new one, fit for the present circumstances.

160100112.text: That new leader is a mirror image of Roland, the Bloodstained Knight.

160100115.text: Right. No matter how strong the compensation is, it will never quite match the functionality of the original organ.

160100116.text: The Roland replica can't possibly imitate Rerir's overwhelming power, nor his ability to disguise himself as others.

160100117.text: So, the Abyss made use of the connection between Roland and Boreas to compensate for this lack of power.

160100118.text: The replica corrupted and took control of Andrius as he slumbered by the bank of Amsvartnir, ultimately manifesting as the giant beast that you all witnessed.

160100119.text: ...However, exactly why the Abyss chose Roland to mimic — and indeed, how it was able to do so — remains unclear.

160100120.text: Hmm. I guess he must've gotten caught up with the Abyss or Nod-Krai somehow during his wanderings through Teyvat... But we can keep those questions on the back burner.

160100121.text: Okay, Paimon gets all that... but what did you mean when you said we can't kill him right now?

160100122.text: We can't kill him right now, because a dead god may prove more dangerous than a living one.

160100123.text: From intelligence gathered during the expedition, we have reason to believe that the power released when a god is felled can have catastrophic consequences for us mortals.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Wolf Spirit's location

160100301.text: #Hey, good to see you again, {NICKNAME}. Oh, Boss Nef asked me to pass on a message!

160100302.text: She went to see Lauma and Columbina at the Frostmoon Scions. Apparently, there haven't been any changes to that space the Rächer of Solnari's in.

160100303.text: That means, the recent Wild Hunt attacks have nothing to do with Rerir, right? Whew, that's a relief... Paimon doesn't fancy facing him again!

160100304.text: They're keeping a close watch on it just in case. With so many moon experts on the case, we're in pretty safe hands, huh?

160100305.text: Oh yeah, Lauma and Columbina asked me to pass on a message, too: "Focus on the enemy you are facing. The moon will protect you all!"

160100306.text: ...You know something? These Knights of Favonius are paying me a pretty nice sum to deliver a few simple messages... Hehe, Varka's a generous guy!

160100401.text: Is this what we're looking for? Um, what do we do with it?

160100402.text: I once got Boreas to explain to me how he stores his soul inside objects. All I need to do is transfer it to my sw{RUBY#[S]claws of steel}ord.

160100403.text: Just like back at the camp... but this time, you'd best step back a bit. Just in case.

160100404.text: ...So you're saying you don't know how to love people, and you don't understand human love either? Pff...

160100406.text: Sorry, I just think... the fact you're ruminating on this is all the proof you need that you have love in your heart.

160100407.text: I have a funny feeling that by the time this journey ends... you'll have found your own answer to the question of how to love...

160100408.text: No, you're wrong. There is no redemption at the end of this path.

160100409.text: ...Even if I am stained black with blood, my conscience will remain as white as snow.

160100410.text: If pledging allegiance to the Abyss is the only way to sever the injustice of fate, then I shall serve in its name.

160100413.text: Sure enough, this place has been corrupted by "Roland's" will... Whew... I'm fine — I was prepared for this. It wasn't enough to pose a serious threat.

160100414.text: We got here just in time. The fragment hasn't been fully corrupted yet. Assuming we can undo the damage, it should still be usable.

160100417.text: Hmm... Purifying the Abyssal corruption would definitely be a safe approach. But that's not the only reason I wanted you to come.

160100418.text: Could you try... reversing the corruption? Not "purifying" it, exactly, but separating out the "Roland" part from the Wolf Spirit.

160100419.text: So... keep the Roland part intact as well as the Wolf Spirit part? Why would you wanna do that?

160100420.text: Firstly, to test whether it's possible... And secondly, to view Roland's memories. As they say, "know thyself, know thy enemy" — understanding our foe is our surest path to defeating him.

160101601.text: Speaking of contingency plans... I now recall that Varka also made a contingency plan when he asked me to deliver that letter.

160101602.text: Hmm, perhaps I should ask Aino to prepare some additional backup modules for me.

160103401.text: Grand Master! Honorary Knight! Thank goodness you're here!

160103402.text: Be careful! There's no end to these monsters... however many we kill, more keep coming!

160103403.text: They've had us penned in so far, but now you're here, maybe we can try getting to the source, which is hidden in the mist. That way, we should be able to cut off the Wild Hunt's reinforcements!

160103404.text: Oh yeah? Then we'll leave that to you! Hey! Everyone hear that? We need to hold the line. Time to give 'em a taste of the Knights of Favonius fighting spirit!

160103501.text: Phew... I'm glad that's finally over.

160103502.text: Use this time to catch your breath, and fill me in on everything you've learned.

160103504.text: We've narrowed down the search area for the final fragment to this zone here...

160103505.text: Yes! Now it feels like we're finally closing in on our target!

160103506.text: I'll say. We're sure to face fierce resistance from the Wild Hunt, though... Do you still have the strength to keep fighting with us?

160103507.text: Absolutely! Good to go, Grand Master!

160103508.text: Much obliged. Alright, the target is just up ahead! Move out!

160103201.text: Ah! It's the Wild Hunt! C'mon, let's go help!

160103202.text: Something's not right... The Wild Hunt's offensive doesn't seem to be getting any weaker as the battle goes on... Are they getting reinforcements from somewhere?

160103203.text: ...Don't get dragged into the enemy's rhythm! Logistics Company, scout out the area — look for terrain we can use to our advantage!

160103204.text: Yes, sir! Reporting in, sir — we've identified viable sites for deploying explosives!

subQuests.subQuestName: Support the Knights of Favonius' squad

160100501.text: Ah! It's the Wild Hunt! C'mon, let's go help!

160100502.text: Something's not right... The Wild Hunt's offensive doesn't seem to be getting any weaker as the battle goes on... Are they getting reinforcements from somewhere?

160100503.text: ...Don't get dragged into the enemy's rhythm! Logistics Company, scout out the area — look for terrain we can use to our advantage!

160100506.text: Reporting in, sir — we've identified viable sites for deploying explosives!

subQuests.subQuestName: Command the Logistics Company to set up traps

160100601.text: ...Short-distance propulsion module on cooldown... 15 minutes until next departure.

160100602.text: #Switching to chat mode — Hello there, Paimon, {NICKNAME}.

160100603.text: Ineffa? What are you doing here...

160100604.text: Varka placed a sizeable order with the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop. Aino is hard at work producing the strategic reserve, while I am handling the deliveries.

160100605.text: Secondly... I am also here to attend the meeting in her place.

160100701.text: Huh? Flins! Paimon thought the Lightkeepers's rep would be Illuga or Nikita...

160100702.text: It's not like you to volunteer to attend a meeting...

160100703.text: You're quite right — however, Illuga and Nikita are both busy organizing the Ratniki's region-wide response to the recent attacks.

160100704.text: And since I'm well-acquainted with everyone else here... I was the one they recommended to attend the meeting.

160100705.text: ...Oh. So you don't even wanna be here!

160100706.text: Heh, sometimes you don't get a choice when there might be consequences down the line.

subQuests.subQuestName: Command the team to feign a retreat

160100801.text: Hey, Honorary Knight. Looks like pretty much everyone's here.

160100802.text: Albedo and Durin are just wrapping up their analysis. You wanna wait for them here?

160100804.text: Great. While we're waiting, could you update me on the situation in Mondstadt?

160100806.text: That works too. Alright, you keep gathering intel.

160100903.text: The enemy has sustained heavy casualties. It should be a while before they're strong enough to pose a real threat again.

160100904.text: Use this time to catch your breath, and fill me in on everything you've learned.

160100906.text: We've narrowed down the search area for the final fragment to this zone here...

160100908.text: We split the search area between us and the Ratniki. Maybe they'll be able to narrow it down further?

160100909.text: Either way, I was about to go lend them a hand next anyway. Do you think you guys can keep up?

160100910.text: Absolutely! Good to go, Grand Master!

160100911.text: We've run right through our supplies — we'll stay here and deal with any Wild Hunt that tries to stage a comeback.

160100912.text: Now that they've lost their numerical advantage, they're no match for us. Focus on supporting the other team.

160103303.text: The enemy has sustained heavy casualties. It should be a while before they're strong enough to pose a real threat again.

160103304.text: Brave knights, on behalf of the Lightkeepers, I thank you for your assistance!

160103305.text: There's no need to be so formal. When it comes to the Abyss, we're all in this together. Now, please tell me everything you've learned.

160103307.text: We've narrowed down the search area for the final fragment to this zone here...

160103309.text: We split the search between us and the knights. Maybe they'll be able to narrow it down further?

160103310.text: Either way, I was about to go lend them a hand next anyway. Can I count on your help?

160103311.text: It would be our pleasure, Mr. Varka.

160103312.text: We've run right through our supplies — we'll stay here and deal with any Wild Hunt that tries to stage a comeback.

160103313.text: Now that they've lost their numerical advantage, they're no match for us. Focus on supporting the other team.

subQuests.subQuestName: Command the Logistics Company to set up traps

160101901.text: Fill me in. What's the situation?

160101902.text: *sigh*... We ran into resistance almost as soon as we set off. Albedo said we should split into two teams and continue searching while he and the others kept the Wild Hunt occupied.

160101903.text: Good call. Locating the Wolf Spirit fragment is our key objective — I would have made the same decision.

160101904.text: Well, it seems the enemy figured as much too! Now both search teams are in big trouble... Oh, I brought a map — this should make things clearer.

160101905.text: Before we ran into trouble, this is the search area we'd decided on...

160101906.text: The two teams are holed up here and here! They should have a clearer idea of the fragment's location by now.

160101907.text: ...But the Wild Hunt is stopping them from relaying messages back, right? Do we have any more troops available to provide backup?

160101908.text: We can't spare troops from any of the fronts right now. That just leaves us with—

160101909.text: The Logistics Company is standing by.

160101911.text: Designated drop point reached. Initiating situation report...

160101912.text: The Logistics Company was assisting Aino with the production of the strategic reserve. But after learning of the situation on the front line, they requested to be dispatched immediately. They are currently nearby awaiting orders.

160101915.text: Amazing... Just in the nick of time.

160101916.text: Hey, seeing as you can fly and all... Shouldn't you be the one out here delivering messages!?

160101917.text: I regret to say that without the workshop's catapult, and with my short-distance propulsion module on cooldown, I will only be able to return to the battlefield after another five minutes. Please, keep up the good work, Jahoda.

160101918.text: The Logistics Company has very limited provisions — only enough for a single battle... Which team should they support?

160101919.text: Both! Once one team has been rescued, the remaining forces will be free to support the other. We'll move out immediately — Jahoda, keep up the good work with the comms!

160101920.text: *gulp*... S—Sure thing! Leave it to me, haha, hah... heh...

subQuests.subQuestName: Command the team to feign a retreat
Go and assist the other squad

160101001.text: Ugh... Looks like the same situation here... They just keep coming, wave after wave.

160101002.text: Reinforcements? ...Hey! You keep them busy while we work on getting rid of this god-awful mist!

160101003.text: Understood! Everyone got that? It's up to us to hold them off!

subQuests.subQuestName: Destroy the source of the Wild Hunt

160101401.text: Phew... I'm glad that's finally over.

160101402.text: Brave knights, on behalf of the Lightkeepers, I thank you for your assistance!

160101403.text: There's no need to be so formal. When it comes to the Abyss, we're all in this together. Now, please tell me everything you've learned.

160101405.text: We've narrowed down the search area for the final fragment to this zone here...

160101406.text: Yes! Now it feels like we're finally closing in on our target!

160101407.text: I'll say. We're sure to face fierce resistance from the Wild Hunt, though... Is everyone willing to keep fighting with us?

160101408.text: It would be our pleasure, Mr. Varka.

160101409.text: Much obliged. Alright, the target is just up ahead! Move out!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Wolf Spirit's location

160102502.text: The hiding-in-the-mist trick again? Heh, these guys must be easily amused.

160102503.text: You all know the drill — the Knights of Favonius will engage the enemy while the Lightkeepers dispel the mist. Everyone, follow my signals!

160102701.text: Ugh! This Wild Hunt doesn't know when to give up!

160102704.text: Mr. Varka! Leave this to us!

160102705.text: Just like last time! Only a Knight of Boreas can deal with a Wolf Spirit, right?

160102706.text: Don't underestimate us, Grand Master! We can hold our own!

160102709.text: Huh... That's the spirit! Stay on your toes, and make the Knights of Favonius proud!

160102710.text: Either we all march back to Mondstadt together, or no one does!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Wolf Spirit's location

160102902.text: It seems you have collected them all, Knight of Boreas.

160102903.text: Yeah, and with no corrupted fragments or ambushes along the way... I have to commend your chivalry, Sir Roland.

160102904.text: A true knight does not resort to underhanded tactics. Were this body not a false one created by the Wild Hunt, nor would I countenance those monsters to taint our duel with their presence.

160102905.text: If you need a moment to rest, take it. Victory will be mine, regardless of whether the path to it is the one I would wish for.

160102906.text: Save your breath! If you want to fight, let's fight!

160102907.text: As you wish... Then let us settle our unfinished duel here and now.

160102909.text: Pff, my granny fights better than these rookies! It's Ekbert I'm worried about... You still alive?

160102910.text: Phew... For a moment there, I thought I might never taste the sweet wine of Mondstadt again.

160102911.text: Hey, stay put, you guys! Leave the rest to us!

160102912.text: Forget us... We can take care of ourselves!

160102913.text: You're the only ones still standing... Honorary Knight, find the Grand Master!

160102914.text: We can't lose our Varka... Please, you have to find him!

160102916.text: (Varka... I hope your plan is still gonna work...)

160102918.text: You're holding back, Knight of Boreas. I can tell you do not wish to strike me down.

160102919.text: This duel does no justice to the way of chivalry. I wield the power of a god, while you dare not swing your sword with true intent. If you continue on this path, you will die.

160102920.text: Your plan is doomed to fail. How can a helpless lamb hope to tame the heart of a wolf when the wolf has seen through the lamb's plan?

160102921.text: Haha... You're onto me already, huh?

160102922.text: Andrius's question, Boreas's answer, the means to bear a soul... I knew it all five hundred years ago.

160102923.text: Though the false path may be wide and welcoming, only destruction lies at its end. It is time to crush your futile hope...

160102925.text: It's over. Your sword lies shattered. The Wolf Spirit and the thoughts you blindly placed your faith in have nowhere left to dwell

160102926.text: Join me, and pledge your allegiance to the Abyss, Knight of Boreas. One day, you will understand that the only righteous path for those of true virtue is the path of darkest truths.

160102929.text: (For the next part, it's over to you...)

160101501.text: Jahoda, you dummy... You took this stupid job of your own free will! Crying isn't gonna get you out of it!

160101701.text: Remnant fragments of an ancient god... thoughts stored inside a blade... Maybe I'm overthinking this, but I suspect there is more to Mr. Varka's plan than what he's revealed to us so far.

160101702.text: Hmm... Then again, the enemy can harness the Wild Hunt to spy on us wherever we go. As our commander, I'm sure he has his reasons for choosing not to tell us everything.

160109901.text: The meeting's probably gonna be in the biggest tent, right? Looks like a bunch of people are there already. Why don't we go chat with them?

160109904.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, when this is all over, I'm gonna invite you around for a drink of—

160109905.text: Whoa, whoa! Stop thinking about Mondstadt's wine and keep your head in the game! You can't be daydreaming about alcohol before a battle!

160109906.text: Huh? Alright, just trying to lift our spirits a little... Uh... Oh — you wanna see some photos I took of me and the knights before the expedition, maybe?

160109907.text: Shut up, shut up, shut up! Can we please just focus on finding the Wolf Spirit fragment!?

160109910.text: Grand Master! Honorary Knight! Thank goodness you're here!

160109911.text: Be careful! There's no end to these monsters... however many we kill, more keep coming!

160109912.text: Just as I thought... Well, they're about to get a shock to the system — we'll wipe 'em out faster than they can replenish their numbers! We just have to hold on until the Logistics Company is ready!

160109914.text: ...Is that the signal to say they're ready?

160109917.text: Hey! They're running out of steam — now's your chance!

160109918.text: Affirmative! Sorry to keep you waiting!

160109919.text: That's their source — it was hidden in the mist! If we destroy that, the Wild Hunt won't be able to summon any more reinforcements!

160109937.text: (...The final fragment is right there... Don't let me down.)
